long_biography.plain_text:
When Deutsche Bank began restructuring its private-equity portfolio, Carlo Pirzio-Biroli helped manage the process and in 2006 co-founded the bank's dedicated secondaries team. He and fellow partners spun that operation out as Glendower Capital in 2017, creating an independent firm focused on buying existing fund interests and constructing liquidity solutions for investors. Pirzio-Biroli served as chief executive and managing partner.

CVC agreed to acquire the partner-owned business in stages, combining cash consideration with interests exchangeable into CVC equity. Glendower became CVC Secondary Partners, and Pirzio-Biroli now heads the strategy as managing partner. Outside investing, he sits on CVC's philanthropy committee and remains a competitive sailor, bringing the same long-horizon discipline to offshore racing.
